digest.component_or_area: RP-04 legacy ambient config/credential read elimination
propositions: ~110 direct ambient environment reads (os.getenv, os.environ, load_config) exist below approved composition seams across reconciler, store, snapshot, io, cli, commands, llm/workflow, and MCP server.
Legacy ambient reads can return inconsistent values during in-progress operations and bypass the central seam, preventing RP-04 completion.

All below-seam ambient config/credential reads, backend reloads, and configurable adapter defaults must be either cut to compose through the approved seam or registered as test-only controls with exact path+symbol+rationale.
The C1 legacy-exception set must be drained to empty with no path-glob exceptions; legacy facades and switches must be removed only after focused suites pass and proof is recorded.

All S1-S6 behavioral suites must pass after each subsystem cutover and legacy-facade removal, with redacted operation snapshot fingerprints and provider-neutral outcomes unchanged except for explicitly recorded approved deltas.
